value.title: Phase 2: Three parallel units
value.summary: Renderer promotion, event stream, tui verb — one coder each.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Each unit SRP behind phase-1 seams; assumptions sections in done reports; absolute paths always.

value.title: u-r renderer promotion: port pocs/human-render into the CLI behind the phase-1 seam — search, doctor, error, status, add, get, tree, remove covered; TTY strategy per the decision function; POC fixtures as goldens; agent-path doc updates (CLAUDE.md, flowspace skill, agents-start-here, self-teaching CLI) in the same unit.
value.success: All four ac-0001 cases green per verb; ac-0002 byte-stability green; docs updated.

value.title: u-w daemon event stream: emit events at work-completion points (scan done, enrich done, queue transitions, root add/remove) and serve status --watch as NDJSON per the frozen wire types; multi-subscriber safe; heartbeat line so consumers detect liveness.
value.success: Two concurrent watchers receive identical streams during a live scan; contract tests over the frozen types.

value.title: u-t the tui verb: ratatui dashboard per scratch/tui-poc (reference, not vendored) — roots, operations with history, activity from the REAL --watch stream (no mock anywhere), in-pane search with results-dominant focus mode; degrades gracefully when the daemon is down (says so, retries).
value.success: Runs over ssh in a plain terminal against the live daemon; activity pane driven by u-w's stream.
